$comment: Bot-session-only settings. Loaded via --settings on top of .claude/settings.json; never active in a normal dev session. Three jobs. (1) enabledPlugins turns the telegram plugin on for THIS session only. It is set to false in ~/.claude/settings.json on purpose: the plugin enabled globally means every Claude session -- the desktop app included -- spawns a getUpdates poller, Telegram allows exactly one consumer per token, and the bot silently receives nothing. Verified: disabled globally the channel is gone even with --channels; re-enabled here the tools come back. (2) Pre-approve every tool the bot AND its three subagents (tg-analyst, tg-tracker, tg-digest) use, because a permission prompt raised while handling a GROUP message can only be answered from the operator's DM -- the plugin deliberately excludes groups from permission_request -- so an unapproved call means the group just watches the typing indicator expire. The channel tools are mcp__plugin_telegram_telegram__* (verified by enumerating a live session's tools); the bare mcp__telegram__* spelling is kept as a fallback in case the namespacing changes. (3) Deny outright the things no group member should ever be able to steer, since deny wins over allow and over the permission mode.
